Accused was arrested at the request of
an agent of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau. He was at one
time Chief of the Propaganda Department of the Chapei District
of the Chinese Communist Youth League and was later promoted
to the position of clerk to the Kiangsu Provincial Committee of
the League. Under the name of Wang Kie Bing (黄建平) he was
charged with being a communist by the French Police on March 14,

APPLICATION FOR DISPOSAL.
Application is hereby made for the disposal of the above
mentioned articles, seized in a rear upstairs room at No.
343 Weihaiwei road at 11.45 a.m. on 22/3/34, same being the
property of one Wang Wei arrested on suspicion of being a
communist at 10.15 p.m. on 21/3/34, on North Szechuen Road
near Haining Road.

Seized:- 1 iron bedstead, one overcoat, 2 round wooden stools,
1 counterpane, 1 pillow, 1 camphor wood chest (unlocked)
2 cover blankets, 1 wooden desk, 1 thermos flask,
1 woollen scarf, 1 ratten chair, and 1 hand mirror.

IN THE 2nd BRANCH OF THE KIANGSU HIGH COURT A.M.

Mr T.Y. Chang appeared for the S.M. Council.

Proceedings. Mr Chang :- If Your Honour please, during the remand
the Police have made enquiries at premises No 4 Lane No 429 Yu Yuen
but find that the accused never lived there. The Police ascertained
however that the accused lived at No 343 Weihaiwei Road. These
premises have been visited by the Police, and this case containing
communistic literature was seized. (Handed to Judge). A list of the
exhibits have made made out, but same has not yet been translated.
On the 14.3.32, this accused was arrested by the French Authorities
and charged with being a Communist. He was subsequently sentenced
to Two Years and Six Months imprisonment, but the accused being
dissatisfied with the Judgment, appealed whereupon the sentence was
reduced to One Year and Eight Months imprisonment (Suspended for
Three Years). This warrant No 507 (handed to Judge), was issued for
the arrest of the accused. If the court is going to hand the accused
over today, then I ask that a ruling be made for the disposal of
the accused's property which was found in his premises at No 343
Weihaiwei Road. The Characters which the accused was requested to
write in court have not yet been examined by the Police.

Subject (in full) Arrest of Communist suspect by Uniform Branch Hongkew on
March 21, at the request of the Public Safety Bureau.
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by J.W.Ru. D.I.

With reference to the literature seized at No. 343 Weihai-
wei Road on March 23. The papers on Esperanto (Exhibit 23)
Wong claimed belonged to a fellow provincial named Li(李) who
returned to Kwangtung about two months ago. Li is alleged to
have studied Esperanto in a Middle School in Nanking for about
one year. It is more probable that Wong has studied Esperanto
in his spare time and at classes which are held regularly in
Shanghai.

The accused speaks, reads and writes Japanese with fluency
and ease and in this connection was in all probability used as a
link between the Chinese, Japanese and Korean Communist Parties.

Relative to Exhibit No. 19, the card bearing the name
"Tseu Siu Vung"(周秀文) was mentioned to the accused Wong Wei,
but he stated he did not know to whom it referred. As to the
second visiting card bearing the name of Waung Jih Hsi(黄直羲),
No. 727 North Szechuen Road, Tel. 46701, this address was
investigated and found to be that of Wong Wei's cousin also a
native of Kwangtung who operates a lodging house there.

In connection with the comparison of the two specimens of
Wong's handwriting, Clerk Ma Yoh states that he is of the
opinion that both were written by the same man. Report by Clerk
Ma Yoh attached.

关于3月23日在威海卫路343号查获的宣传品。有关世界语的文件（证物23）
黄声称属于一位名叫李（Li）的同乡，此人
约两个月前返回广东。据称李曾在南京的一所中学
学习世界语约一年。更有可能的是，黄是在业余时间
以及在上海定期举办的班级中学习的世界语。

被告能流利轻松地讲、读、写日语，
在这方面，他很可能被用作中国、日本和朝鲜共产党之间的联络人。

关于证物第19号，印有“周秀文”(Tseu Siu Vung)名字的名片
已向被告黄维提及，但他表示不知道这指的是谁。至于第二张
印有黄直羲（Waung Jih Hsi）名字的名片，地址为四川北路727号，电话46701，
经调查，该地址是黄维表亲的住所，他也是广东人，
在那里经营一家旅馆。

关于比对黄的两份笔迹样本，职员马耀（Ma Yoh）表示，他认为
这两份样本均由同一人书写。附马耀的报告。

on March 21 at the request of the Public Safety Bureau.
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by A.B.Km D.I.

With reference to the arrest of Wong Wei(黄维) communist
suspect, who was taken into custody at 10.25 p.m. on March 21.
Examination of this man's fingerprint record showed that he has
a previous conviction for Communist activities. He was arrested
by the French Police on March 14, 1932, on Avenue Dubail together
with one Woo Piau Gni( ) who was later released. Wong
Wei under the name of Wong Kai Ping( ) was sentenced to
two and a half years imprisonment but appealed the case when the
sentence was reduced to one year and eight months and suspended
for three years. He was eventually released by the French
Police in January 1933.

Zung Ying(郑英), agent of the Bureau of Public Safety
who caused the arrest of Wong Wei on March 21, 1934, when
questioned regarding the evidence held in the case, by the
Public Safety Bureau, made the following statements:-

I first became a Communist in August 1933 and at about
the same time met Wong Wei. At that time I was living at No.3
Sung Nyi Li, Elgin Road. Wong was acting as the Chief of the
Propaganda Department of the Chapei District Committee, of the
Communist Party, and residing at No.48 Continental Terrace (Dah
Loh Li), Scott Road. Later, however, from some unknown reason
he moved away and, I believe, went to live at No.4 Lane 419 Yu
Yuen Road. I have a draft of a handbill in my possession which
was written by Wong during his term of office as the Chief of the
Propaganda Department of the Chapei District Committee, and will
produce it if necessary.

The document abovementioned was produced at 11 a.m. on
March 23, 1934 and will be submitted to the handwriting-expert
for examination and comparison with samples of Wong's handwriting

关于黄维（Wong Wei）这名共产党嫌疑犯的逮捕事宜，他于3月21日晚上10点25分被拘留。对此人的指纹记录进行检查后发现，他有从事共产党活动的前科。他于1932年3月14日在杜美路（Avenue Dubail）与一名叫吴彪尼（Woo Piau Gni，音译）的人一同被法国警察逮捕，后者后来获释。黄维化名黄凯平（Wong Kai Ping，音译）被判处两年半监禁，但对判决提出上诉，刑期减为一年八个月，缓刑三年。他最终于1933年1月被法国警察释放。

郑英（Zung Ying），公安局特工，于1934年3月21日导致黄维被捕，当被公安局问及本案持有的证据时，作出了以下陈述：

我于1933年8月首次成为共产党员，并在大约同一时间认识了黄维。当时我住在爱而近路宋义里3号。黄当时担任共产党闸北区委员会宣传部长，居住在斯科特路大陆里（Dah Loh Li）48号。然而，后来由于某种未知原因他搬走了，我相信他搬到了愚园路419弄4号居住。我手头有一份传单草稿，是黄在担任共产党闸北区委员会宣传部长期间撰写的，如有需要我将出示。

上述文件已于1934年3月23日上午11点出示，并将提交给笔迹专家进行检查，并与黄被捕后在本办公室获取的笔迹样本进行比对

Translation of a draft of a communist handbill alleged
to have been written by Wong Fei(黃飛 ) arrested on
North Szechmen Road near Haining Road on 21.3.34, and
obtained from the Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety.

Manifesto in connection with the Anniversary
of the October Revolution.

To the oppressed poor and labour masses,

The success of the Russian Revolution was achieved on
the day of the anniversary of the October Revolution. This
anniversary is really a dual one because on the same day
two years ago the Provisional Government of Soviet China
came into existence. What a great anniversary this is!
Not only the poor and labouring masses of China but those
throughout the world will celebrate this anniversary of
important significance.

Under the leadership of Comrade Lenin, the U.S.S.R.
effected the emancipation of 160,000,000 labourers, peasants
and poor people in their country; and under the leadership
of Comrade Stalin, they completed the Five Year Plan in
four years, thus consolidating the economic foundation of
the socialists. At this moment when large numbers of
workers are out of employment in various capitalistic
countries, the U.S.S.R. are not troubled by unemployment;
on the contrary they enlist workers from Germany, France
and the U.S.A. The U.S.S.R. is greatly different to a
capitalistic country: the former is a government of liberated
labourers and peasants or we may say it is a paradise of
human beings whilst the latter often throw the majority
of its people into poverty and starvation.

The true emancipation of the people in the U.S.S.R.
was not realized only after energetic struggles conducted
by millions of labourers, peasants and party members. In
celebrating the anniversary of October Revolution, we should
follow their example so as to bring about the emancipation
of the Chinese nation. We must support the U.S.S.R. and
protect it by force of arms against the interference of
imperialistic nations. As the Japanese robbers recently
planned to forcibly seize the Chinese Eastern Railway with
the ultimate object of attacking the U.S.S.R., we should
rise up at once and help our labour and peasant brothers
of the U.S.S.R. in the fight against the Japanese and other
imperialists.

The U.S.S.R. is our mother country. It is the only
good friend of the weak and minor races and is the base for
operations against international capitalism.

The Provisional Government of Soviet China was inaugurat-
ed on November 7 last year in Jaking, Kiangsi. Despite
the Anti-Communist Campaign conducted by the Kuomintang on
four different occasions, the Soviet Government is as safe
as ever owing to the bravery of the Red Armies who defeated
the Kuomintang troops during each campaign. Now the
Kuomintang is planning to carry out the 5th Anti-Communist
Campaign at the instigation of imperialists. We might say
that the Kuomintang is the "pioneer" of the imperialists
as it clears the way for imperialists by killing revolutionary
warriors and oppressing the people to the point of death.
It is further giving away one province after another to the
imperialists and is practically transforming China into an
imperialistic colony.

Dear oppressed youths! As the crisis of the Chinese
nation is drawing nearer and nearer, we cannot remain
indifferent any longer. Let us effect our emancipation by
overthrowing the Kuomintang and imperialists, supporting the
U.S.S.R. by force of arms, and enforcing racial unity.

Propaganda Dept., Chapei Branching Committee,
C.P. League.

关于十月革命周年纪念的宣言。

致受压迫的贫苦大众和劳工群众，

俄国革命的成功是在十月革命周年纪念日那天取得的。这个纪念日实际上是双重的，因为两年前的同一天，中华苏维埃临时政府成立了。这是多么伟大的纪念日啊！不仅中国的贫苦大众和劳工群众，而且全世界的民众都将庆祝这个具有重要意义的纪念日。

在列宁同志的领导下，苏联实现了该国1亿6千万劳动者、农民和穷人的解放；在斯大林同志的领导下，他们在四年内完成了五年计划，从而巩固了社会主义的经济基础。当各个资本主义国家大量工人失业之时，苏联并未受到失业问题的困扰；相反，他们从德国、法国和美国招募工人。苏联与资本主义国家大不相同：前者是解放了的劳动者和农民的政府，或者我们可以说它是人类的天堂，而后者往往使其大多数人民陷入贫困和饥饿之中。

苏联人民的真正解放，是经过数百万劳动者、农民和党员进行的激烈斗争后才实现的。在庆祝十月革命纪念日之际，我们应该效仿他们的榜样，以实现中华民族的解放。我们必须支持苏联，并以武力保护它，防止帝国主义国家的干涉。由于日本强盗最近策划强行夺取中东铁路，其最终目的是进攻苏联，我们应该立即行动起来，帮助我们在苏联的劳工和农民兄弟对抗日本及其他帝国主义者。

苏联是我们的祖国。它是弱小民族唯一的好朋友，也是反对国际资本主义的行动基地。

中华苏维埃临时政府于去年11月7日在江西瑞金成立。尽管国民党进行了四次“围剿”，但由于红军在每次战役中击败国民党军队，苏维埃政府依然安然无恙。现在，国民党在帝国主义的唆使下，正计划进行第五次“围剿”。我们可以说，国民党是帝国主义的“先锋”，因为它通过杀害革命战士并将人民压迫至死，为帝国主义扫清道路。它进一步将一个又一个省份割让给帝国主义，实际上正在将中国变成帝国主义的殖民地。

亲爱的受压迫青年们！随着中华民族危机的日益临近，我们不能再保持冷漠了。让我们通过推翻国民党和帝国主义、以武力支持苏联以及实行种族团结来实现我们的解放。

共产党联盟闸北分支委员会宣传部。

Wong Wei(黄维)
Kwangtung
D.S.I. Golder
Section 2, S.B. March 23, 1934. Clerks Liao & Chew.

My name is Wong Wei, aged 25, native of Chun San Hsien
(中山縣,), Kwangtung. At the age of 6 or 7 I entered a primary
school in my native place. I left this school at the age of
13 and entered the local middle school, where I studied for a
further period of six years. Immediately after leaving the
middle school which was when I was about 20 years, I went to
Japan where I studied in the Meiji University, Tokio, where I
remained until the Japanese occupation of Manchuria in September
1931, when I came to Shanghai. For several months after my
arrival in Shanghai I was ill and remained in my lodging at
No.25 (?) Boppe Faung, Rue August Boppe, French Concession.
On regaining my health I took up a position as a teacher in
the Ai Jung Primary School, Haining Road. Whilst I was
employed by this establishment I was living in the Yuen Chang
Li, Route Vallon, French Concession. I do not remember the
number of the house. I resided at the last named address up
until the time I was arrested by the French Police in February
1932, for communist activities. I was at first sentenced to
two and a half years imprisonment but appealed the case when
the sentence was reduced to one year and eight months and
suspended for three years. My appeal took a long time going
through the Courts; I was thus not released by the French
Police until some time in January 1933. Upon my release I
went to live in the Hung Yue Faung off Avenue Road where I
paid $12.00 per month for rent and food. Two months later I
moved to Sing You Tseng alleyway, Ferry Road.
After residing there for two months I obtained a job as

我叫 Wong Wei，25岁，籍贯广东中山县（Chun San Hsien）。我在6或7岁时进入家乡的一所小学读书。13岁时离开该校，进入当地中学，又读了六年。中学毕业后不久，当时我大约20岁，我去了日本，在东京明治大学学习，一直待到1931年9月日本占领满洲，随后我来到上海。抵达上海后的几个月里，我生病了，住在法租界奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue August Boppe）博佩坊（Boppe Faung）25号（？）的寓所里。恢复健康后，我在海宁路的爱群小学担任教师。受雇于该校期间，我住在法租界华伦路（Route Vallon）元昌里。我不记得门牌号码了。我一直居住在上述地址，直到1932年2月因共产主义活动被法国警察逮捕。起初我被判处两年半监禁，但我提出了上诉，刑期减为一年零八个月，缓刑三年。我的上诉在法院审理了很长时间；因此，直到1933年1月的某个时候，我才被法国警察释放。获释后，我搬到大西路（Avenue Road）旁的宏裕坊居住，每月支付12.00美元作为房租和伙食费。两个月后，我搬到了斐伦路（Ferry Road）的新有增弄。
在那里住了两个月后，我找到了一份工作

a teacher in the Tsing Foong Primary School, North Kiangse
Road, and went to live at No.45 Continental Terrace (Dah Leh
Li), Scott Road. Whilst living at the Scott Road address I
became friendly with one named Zung Ying(鄭英) who claimed
to be a friend of the No.1 tenant of the house and who caused
my arrest on March 21, 1934. In September 1933 I left Scott
Road and went to live in the Yoong Sing Li, North Kiangse Road,
staying there until the end of November when I moved to No.15 ?
Zoen Ching Faung, Chinhai Road. After staying here for a period
of about two months I went to No.4 Zung Tuh Faung, Avenue Road,
(the address at which my belongings were found) on the day of
my arrest.

Since January 1934 when I lost my position with
the Tsing Foong Primary School I have lived on what money I
saved, eked out with a small allowance from my father Wong Bei
Ching(黄佩卿), a sundry-goods dealer in Chun San Hsien,
Kwangtung.

I have not at any time been a member of the Communist
Party nor have I made a habit of associating with members of
that political organisation. My arrest by the French Police
in 1932 was not because I was guilty of being an active
Communist but owing to a miscarriage of justice. I was waiting
for a tramcar on Avenue Dubail when a Chinese pasted a Communist
poster on a nearby wall. He then ran away and I was arrested
by the Police. The Communist books and pamphlets found in my
belongings were left behind by a friend of mine named Li Tsen
(      ) who left for Kwangtung at the end of January 1934.

自1934年1月失去清风小学的职位以来，我一直靠积蓄生活，并由我在广东中山县经营杂货店的父亲 Wong Bei Ching（黄佩卿）提供少量津贴予以补充。

我任何时候都不是共产党员，也没有养成与该政治组织成员交往的习惯。1932年被法国警察逮捕，并非因为我犯有积极从事共产主义活动的罪行，而是由于司法不公。当时我正在杜拜尔路（Avenue Dubail）等候电车，一名中国人在附近的墙上张贴了一张共产党海报。随后他逃跑了，而我被警察逮捕。在我物品中发现的共产党书籍和小册子是我的朋友 Li Tsen（      ）留下的，他于1934年1月底前往广东。

Accused denied all connection with the Communist Party or other reactionary organisation. He gave his present address as House No. 4, Lane 419, Yuyuen Road, where he was staying with his uncle, Wong Dzoong Yui, 黄仲禹, but on this place being visited, his uncle was absent, and none of the inmates present could confirm his statement.

At that time, accused was Chief of the Propaganda Department of the Chapel District Committee of the Communist Youth League. In the latter part of 1933, Zung severed his connection with the Communist Party, and now devotes his time in the interest of the Kuomintang. Zung further stated that he has information to the effect that accused has been promoted to the post of Secretary (Clerk) of the Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League, but he was unable to furnish proof of any of his allegations.

My name is Wong Wei, 25, single, native of Canton, teacher by profession, at present residing at Lane 419, House No.4 Yu Yuen Road.

I studied for 10 years in a Higher middle school in Canton and after studied in Shanghai under a Private Japanese teacher in order to learn Japanese, which I now speak fairly well.

I first arrived in Shanghai in August 1931 with the object of studying Japanese and English, of which latter language I now have no knowledge. I resided at a hotel on the corner of Foochow and Hokien Roads corner and then at Avenue Dubail where I remained until the outbreak of the local Sino-Japanese hostilities in February 1932 when I returned to Canton, where I stayed with my family until January 1933.

I then returned to Shanghai and put up in a house in the Ching Yue Fong (慶餘坊) Hankow Rd where I remained for 2 months. I did no work during this period, after which I removed to Sing Yue Li (永裕村) Ferry Road, staying there also 2 months. During this time I taught at the Ching Tsong Primary School (清風), No.9, Kung FoolLi, North Kiangse Road. From Ferry Road I removed to No.45 Dah Loh Li (大陸新村) off Scott Road, staying there until the end of September, when I removed to Yang Shing Li (榮陞里) North Kiangse Road, near the above School at which I was still teaching. I stayed there until the end of December, when I again shifted quarters - this time to Ching Yuen Li, Chin Lai Road, where I stayed for one month, after which I went to Nanking to see a fellow country man named Chu Tseu Vung (周九文).
